case_count: 7 pilot tables and 127 full tables. Assignment count exactly sum_R [product_j(1+degree_R(j))-1], verified by completed enumeration. Read-once cases 29; seven sharpness cases. Main g<=|A|<=3, so polynomial determinants are at most 2 by 2.

arithmetic: integers, Fraction exact rational polynomials, determinant permutation expansion, separate chronological queue traces; no floating-point sign or approximate entropy comparison
resource_rules: one foreground job at a time; no job above 300 MB planned, no GPU, no automatic dimension escalation
known_limits: These exact checks validate combinatorial mass and all-width-review identities, not a universal FEI sign. Exact algebraic b_tau is handled by the analytic factor identity; no irrational B evaluation is used in this job. Runtime from perf_counter is display/resource evidence only.
